verses.en: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
verses.pt: Vós, senhores, dai a vossos servos o que é de justiça e eqüidade, sabendo que também vós tendes um Senhor no céu.
verses.en_web: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
verses.en_bbe: Masters, give your servants what is right and equal, conscious that you have a Master in heaven.

verses.en: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
verses.pt: Perseverai na oração, velando nela com ações de graças,
verses.en_web: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;
verses.en_bbe: Give yourselves to prayer at all times, keeping watch with praise;

verses.en: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
verses.pt: orando ao mesmo tempo também por nós, para que Deus nos abra uma porta à palavra, a fim de falarmos o mistério de Cristo, pelo qual também estou preso,
verses.en_web: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;
verses.en_bbe: And making prayer for us, that God may give us an open door for the preaching of the word, the secret of Christ, for which I am now in chains;

verses.en: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
verses.pt: para que eu o manifeste como devo falar.
verses.en_web: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
verses.en_bbe: So that I may make it clear, as it is right for me to do.

verses.en: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
verses.pt: Andai em sabedoria para com os que estão de fora, usando bem cada oportunidade.
verses.en_web: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
verses.en_bbe: Be wise in your behaviour to those who are outside, making good use of the time.

verses.en: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
verses.pt: A vossa palavra seja sempre com graça, temperada com sal, para saberdes como deveis responder a cada um.
verses.en_web: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
verses.en_bbe: Let your talk be with grace, mixed with salt, so that you may be able to give an answer to everyone.

verses.en: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
verses.pt: Tíquico, o irmão amado, fiel ministro e conservo no Senhor, vos fará conhecer a minha situação;
verses.en_web: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Tychicus will give you news of all my business: he is a dear brother and true servant and helper in the word;

verses.en: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
verses.pt: o qual vos envio para este mesmo fim, para que saibais o nosso estado e ele conforte os vossos corações,
verses.en_web: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
verses.en_bbe: And I have sent him to you for this very purpose, so that you may have news of how we are, and so that he may give your hearts comfort;

verses.en: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
verses.pt: juntamente com Onésimo, fiel e amado irmão, que é um de vós; eles vos farão saber tudo o que aqui se passa.
verses.en_web: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
verses.en_bbe: And with him I have sent Onesimus, the true and well-loved brother, who is one of you. They will give you word of everything which is taking place here.

verses.en: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
verses.pt: Saúda-vos Aristarco, meu companheiro de prisão, e Marcos, o primo de Barnabé (a respeito do qual recebestes instruções; se for ter convosco, recebei-o),
verses.en_web: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received commandments, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
verses.en_bbe: Aristarchus, my brother-prisoner, sends his love to you, and Mark, a relation of Barnabas (about whom you have been given orders: if he comes to you, be kind to him),

verses.en: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellow workers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
verses.pt: e Jesus, que se chama Justo, sendo unicamente estes, dentre a circuncisão, os meus cooperadores no reino de Deus; os quais têm sido para mim uma consolação.
verses.en_web: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, whose other name is Justus; these are of the circumcision: they are my only brother-workers for the kingdom of God, who have been a comfort to me.

verses.en: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
verses.pt: Saúda-vos Epafras, que é um de vós, servo de Cristo Jesus, e que sempre luta por vós nas suas orações, para que permaneçais perfeitos e plenamente seguros em toda a vontade de Deus.
verses.en_web: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
verses.en_bbe: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you his love, ever taking thought for you in his prayers, that you may be complete and fully certain of all the purpose of God.

verses.en: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
verses.pt: Pois dou-lhe testemunho de que tem grande zelo por vós, como também pelos que estão em Laodicéia, e pelos que estão em Hierápolis.
verses.en_web: For I testify about him, that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
verses.en_bbe: For I give witness of him that he has undergone much trouble for you and for those in Laodicea and in Hierapolis.

verses.en: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
verses.pt: Saúda-vos Lucas, o médico amado, e Demas.
verses.en_web: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you.
verses.en_bbe: Luke, our well-loved medical friend, and Demas, send you their love.

verses.en: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
verses.pt: Saudai aos irmãos que estão em Laodicéia, e a Ninfas e a igreja que está em sua casa.
verses.en_web: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly that is in his house.
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to the brothers in Laodicea and to Nymphas and the church in their house.

verses.en: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
verses.pt: Depois que for lida esta carta entre vós, fazei que o seja também na igreja dos laodicenses; e a de Laodicéia lede-a vós também.
verses.en_web: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans; and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
verses.en_bbe: And when this letter has been made public among you, let the same be done in the church of Laodicea; and see that you have the letter from Laodicea.

verses.en: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
verses.pt: E dizei a Arquipo: Cuida do ministério que recebestes no Senhor, para o cumprires.
verses.en_web: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
verses.en_bbe: Say to Archippus, See that you do the work which the Lord has given you to do.

verses.en: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.pt: Esta saudação é de próprio punho, de Paulo. Lembrai-vos das minhas cadeias. A graça seja convosco.
verses.en_web: The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: I, Paul, give you this word of love in my handwriting. Keep in memory that I am a prisoner. Grace be with you.
